title: Smith Hollow Farm

services.name: Pumpkin Patch
services.desc: Mark your calendars for FALL ON THE FARM at Smith Hollow Farm. We will be open for corn maze, pumpkin patch, hayride, animal viewing & more! One ride is included with admission - choose either the Fire Engine Train or Barrel Train. Additional rides are $4 each. $10 per ride. Riders must be over 40 inches tall and under 18 years old. For the safety of our horses, rides may be paused on especially hot days. Only ADA-recognized service animals specifically trained to perform tasks for individuals with disabilities are permitted. Emotional support, therapy, and comfort animals do not qualify under ADA guidelines and are not allowed. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation in helping us
